name: dahsha
description: Dahsha (دهشة): full-length documentaries in Arabic and English from YouTube, grouped by show and topic, refreshed automatically.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.publish: npm run refresh-data && npm run export && npm run build:static && vercel deploy --prod --yes
